title: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act — Statute profile
subject: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
summary: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is a statute of United States enacted in 2010, in the area of financial regulation. Sweeping financial reform responding to the 2008 financial crisis. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 111-203.
key_points: Core effect: Sweeping financial reform responding to the 2008 financial crisis.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
